g1-implement.title: G1 reproduce scoreboard + read-only representation probe (no retrain)
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G1. (1) Regenerate quali same-pairs inference records from the committed bundle gold_cycle_260608_043414_2018thru2024 (worktree params/gold/runtime_bundles) via run.py backtest-latent-power-module --emit-module-record for driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend AND driver_quali_power_from_recent_history, years 2018-2024 + 2025; write records under .agent-work/451/records (gitignore-safe scratch). DBs at C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data, retro at C:/Programs/f1Brainz/params/retro_truth. (2) Run scripts/diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py against those records; confirm headline rw~0.6149 / rh~0.7803 / ceiling 0.8061 / 23862 pairs OR flag and record the reproduced numbers as the working baseline (bundle is anchor-active-trained, may differ). (3) READ-ONLY REPRESENTATION PROBE: on the SAME shared non-tie pairs, fit a per-event-pooled LINEAR readout (logistic on the antisymmetric pairwise feature DIFFERENCES the head ingests, from quali_power_adapter) of Q-order, walk-forward (fit on train years, score held-out) and report its same-pairs sign accuracy vs the head (0.615) and vs the min-sector ceiling (0.806). Interpretation: if a linear readout of the head's OWN input features lands near the head (~0.62) and well below ceiling, the pace-ordering signal is NOT linearly present in the feature vector -> representation-lossy; if it lands near ceiling, the info IS present and the head fails to use it (signal/capacity). Write all numbers to .agent-work/451/evidence/g1_numbers.json. NO retrain, NO param/src change. Dispatch constellation-implementer (Sonnet). Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g2-implement.title: G2 feature-ablation retrain: add min-sector pace ordering as one head input feature
g2-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G2. Decisive (a)-vs-(b/c) test via single-module ablation retrains using run.py train-latent-power-module for driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend (train-years 2018-2024 LOSO-style per the harness regime, retro-root C:/Programs/f1Brainz/params/retro_truth, compound-prior-root params/gold/compound_prior, DBs at C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data). Run TWO retrains, each scored on the §7.6.2 same-pairs harness (regenerate records from the freshly trained bundle, same harness as G1): (A) AS-IS control retrain (current 23 features, current width/epochs) -> expect ~0.615; establishes the retrain reproduces the deficit and it is intrinsic, not a stale-bundle artifact. (B) +PACE-FEATURE retrain: add ONE feature to the head input path = the within-event min-sector best_across_fp pace ordering (the same anchor signal whose ceiling is 0.806; per-driver scalar, fed as an antisymmetric pairwise diff like the others), in a SCRATCH/branch-local edit to quali_power_adapter (do NOT touch promoted defaults; keep it flag/temp so it is reversible). Score on the harness. Keep each retrain foreground and bounded (<=10 min; poll). If feature (B) closes the bulk of the gap (toward ~0.74-0.80) while (A) reproduces ~0.615, hypothesis (a) representation is CONFIRMED (the info was absent from the feature vector and is learnable once supplied). If (B) does NOT close the gap, representation is NOT the lever -> training-signal/capacity. Write numbers to .agent-work/451/evidence/g2_numbers.json. Respect walk-forward as-of (the pace feature is as-of FP data, pre-Q). Dispatch constellation-implementer (Sonnet). Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
